case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly identifies the goroutine leak described in the rubric, explaining clearly how an unbuffered channel causes the spawned goroutine to block indefinitely when ctx.Done() triggers. It recommends both suggested solutions from the rubric: buffering the channel with capacity 1 and propagating context to the backend. It also provides valuable, actionable feedback regarding unit testing with leak detection.
findings: Accurately identified the goroutine leak caused by sending to an unbuffered channel after early return on context cancellation.
Recommended the exact fixes specified in the rubric: buffering the channel (make(chan fetchResult, 1)) and propagating context to the backend.
Highlighted additional practical concerns without false positives, such as orphaned background backend requests and lack of leak-testing.
